```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(SeuratObject)
library(here)
```

```{r}
so <- read_rds("/mnt/data/data/kang2018.rds")
```

```{r}
so_list <- SplitObject(so, "ind")
#so_list["107"] <- NULL # There's actually no 107 in the data
```

```{r}
for (s in so_list) {
  name = as.character(s$ind[[1]][1])
  path = paste0("/mnt/data/data/", name, ".rds")
  print(path)
  saveRDS(s, path)
}
```
